category: managed Apache Cassandra and vector database

free_tier.stated: Organizations on the Free plan receive a fixed amount of credits each month. No more than five Astra DB Serverless databases.
free_tier.notes: The free allowance is a fixed number of credits per month, not a fixed byte count. Unused credits do not roll over and reset on the first of every month. Storage itself has no practical byte limit on a Serverless database.

per_object_cap.stated: There is no practical limit to the number of bytes an Astra DB Serverless database can store.
per_object_cap.notes: the cap that binds is the monthly credit allowance and the maximum of five databases, not a per-object size

retention.stated: Inactive Astra DB Serverless databases are automatically hibernated and scheduled for deletion
retention.notes: days null is activity-based: hibernation and scheduled deletion follow inactivity, and a database suspended for exhausted credits stays inaccessible until the credits refresh or the plan is upgraded

egress.terms: Data transfer out of a database, including internet egress and cross-region replication, is billed in credits per GB; the free plan draws from the monthly credit allowance

interface_detail: Data API over HTTP for collections and tables, the DevOps API for management, CQL over the Cassandra wire protocol with a Secure Connect Bundle, and the Astra CLI
tooling: Astra Data API clients, Cassandra drivers with a Secure Connect Bundle, cqlsh, and the astra CLI
chaining: a free Serverless database can back an app through the HTTP Data API and be paired with other free hosts; at most five databases and the monthly credit refresh bound the chain

limits.value: No more than five Astra DB Serverless databases on Free
databases are suspended when the monthly credit allowance is consumed and cannot be accessed until credits refresh or the plan is upgraded
inactive databases are automatically hibernated and scheduled for deletion on the Free plan

binding_note: the fixed monthly credit allowance suspends databases once spent, which binds before the five-database count for an active workload

identity_cost.detail: You can create an Astra account manually or use SSO to automatically provision an account through your IdP, Google, GitHub, or IBMid account. Your email address is the unique identifier for your Astra account. The manual route is a username and password; no card is named at signup.

reliability_note: a Free database is suspended when monthly credits run out and its data is inaccessible until credits refresh or the plan is upgraded; inactive databases are hibernated and scheduled for deletion. The amount of free credits is not published on the pages read, so the exact ceiling is unknown.
confidence_note: all values are from first-party DataStax docs pages read today; the credit amount is not published there and is left unverified, and no probe was run

evidence.quote: Organizations on the Free plan receive a fixed amount of credits each month.
evidence.proved: the free allowance is a fixed monthly amount of credits

evidence.quote: No more than five Astra DB Serverless databases.
evidence.proved: the Free plan is limited to five Serverless databases

evidence.quote: Inactive Astra DB Serverless databases are automatically [hibernated and scheduled for deletion](https://docs.datastax.com/en/astra-db-serverless/databases/database-statuses.html#hibernated).
evidence.proved: inactive free databases are hibernated and scheduled for deletion

evidence.quote: There is no practical limit to the number of bytes an Astra DB Serverless database can store.
evidence.proved: there is no byte cap on a Serverless database

evidence.quote: For Astra organizations on the Free plan, Astra DB Serverless databases are suspended if your monthly credits run out. While suspended, you cannot access the data in the database.
evidence.proved: exhausted monthly credits suspend the database and block access to its data

evidence.quote: Unused free credits don’t roll over to the next month. Free monthly credits reset on the first of every month for all organizations on the Free plan.
evidence.proved: free credits reset monthly and do not carry over

evidence.quote: You can create an Astra account manually or use SSO to automatically provision an account through your IdP, Google, GitHub, or IBMid account.
evidence.proved: signup uses email/password or SSO, with no card or phone required

notes: The numeric amount of free monthly credits is unverified: it is not stated on the DataStax subscription-plans, subscription-usage or FAQ pages read today, and the IBM pricing page answered HTTP 403. Astra is a Serverless Cassandra and vector store, not a general object store, so the lack of a byte cap does not make the credit ceiling irrelevant. The interface is set from the Data API, DevOps API, CQL and CLI documented across the first-party pages.
